metadata.description: Agent skills for Obsidian workflows, organized into granular bundles by domain: notes, querying, automation, workflows, development, plugin devkit, plugin UI, visuals, media, Gemini API, Extended Graph, Smart Connections, Breadcrumbs, and NoteMD Pro.

plugins.name: obsidian-skills-notes
plugins.description: Core note authoring and vault structure: Markdown syntax, wiki-links, YAML frontmatter, Bases database views, Obsidian references, vault management, and clean web-to-markdown extraction via Defuddle.

plugins.name: obsidian-skills-plugins
plugins.description: Third-party Obsidian plugin usage: Dataview/Datacore queries, Templater templates, Tasks management, Advanced Canvas, BRAT beta installs, Claudian AI assistant, internetVin Terminal, VIVA LLM voice chat, and Viva Examiner.

plugins.name: obsidian-skills-automation
plugins.description: CLI operations, headless sync, scheduled jobs, and vault commands: Obsidian CLI for live app control, obsidian-headless (ob) for server sync, obc vault intelligence commands, and cron/launchd scheduling.

plugins.name: obsidian-skills-workflows
plugins.description: AI-augmented PKM workflows: interactive writing assistance, adaptive learning-path generation, memory consolidation (obsidian-dream), MCP Apps and elicitation architecture, AI4PKM orchestration, and Gobi onboarding.

plugins.name: obsidian-skills-dev
plugins.description: Obsidian plugin and theme development: feature implementation, debugging, DevTools inspection, project ops, theme CSS/SCSS, code-intelligence graphs, skill discovery and authoring.

plugins.name: obsidian-skills-gemini
plugins.description: Gemini API development: text generation, multimodal understanding, Interactions API, and Live API real-time streaming with voice/video.

plugins.name: obsidian-skills-plugin-devkit
plugins.description: Obsidian plugin development toolkit: scaffolding, lifecycle and memory safety, type safety, file operations, accessibility, code quality, UI/UX copy, CSS styling, and submission readiness.

plugins.name: obsidian-skills-plugin-ui
plugins.description: React-based Obsidian plugin UI: shadcn/ui integration and CLI workflows, component architecture and composition, visual styling and theming, and React performance optimization.

plugins.name: obsidian-skills-visual
plugins.description: Visual knowledge mapping: Obsidian Canvas, JSON Canvas spec, Excalidraw diagrams, Mermaid flowcharts, and Markdown slide decks.

plugins.name: obsidian-skills-media
plugins.description: Media production and document conversion: DOCX/EPUB to Markdown import, video transcription and cleaning, chapter generation, slide-to-video rendering, YouTube transcript summarization, and Gemini image generation.

plugins.name: obsidian-skills-extended-graph
plugins.description: Extended Graph plugin development: new features, stat calculators, settings sections, and interactive filter types following project conventions.

plugins.name: obsidian-skills-smart-connections
plugins.description: Smart Connections plugin development: component patterns, view and command wiring, collection/action pipelines, and Ava regression and migration tests.

plugins.name: obsidian-skills-breadcrumbs
plugins.description: Breadcrumbs plugin documentation: page navigation, content editing, terminology enforcement, vault conventions, development workflow, and docs integrity validation.

plugins.name: obsidian-skills-notemdpro
plugins.description: NoteMD Pro markdown processing: batch operations, concept extraction, content generation, formula and Mermaid healing, link analysis, QA extraction, translation, web research, and architecture/testing workflows.

plugins.name: obsidian-skills-all
plugins.description: Every skill in this marketplace. Install this if you want the complete set without choosing individual bundles.
